claim_ceiling: Independent fixed-step and adaptive step-doubled Sachs/Jacobi optical-geodesic formulations. No caustic, fold/cusp or wave-optics claim until exact Schwarzschild, cross-step refinement and canonical-vs-Sachs agreement pass.

conventions.chart_state_order: (t_bar or v_bar, r_bar, theta, phi, p_t, p_r, p_theta, p_phi)
conventions.tangent: k^mu = dx^mu/dlambda from the canonical Kerr Hamiltonian
conventions.screen: two contravariant chart-coordinate basis vectors e_A^mu orthonormal and transverse to k
conventions.tidal_matrix: T_AB = R_(mu nu rho sigma) e_A^mu k^nu e_B^rho k^sigma
conventions.vertex_conditions: D(0)=0; D'(0)=I_2 under the declared local-energy/affine normalization
conventions.vectorization: row-major 2x2 D and D'; MSB-first qubit convention not applicable
conventions.solver: classical fixed-step RK4 over a coupled 24-component state; no adaptive error estimate

diagnostics: signed determinant, singular values and condition number
implementation.adaptive_integrator: step-doubled classical RK4; full step compared with two half steps, with the two-half-step state accepted
adaptive_diagnostics: maximum scaled local error per channel
last accepted and next proposed step

compare: relative Jacobi-matrix change between 2N and 4N while well-conditioned
null, screen and tidal residual envelopes
canonical fundamental-matrix projection after transforming into the same transported screen frame
refinement_protocol.adaptive_comparison: On identical initial data, compare adaptive output with the highest-resolution fixed-step result. The adaptive step-doubling estimate is a local controller, not a rigorous global bound.

negative_controls: freshly reseed a local screen basis independently at every step instead of integrating parallel transport
interpolate screen components across the observer-sky chart seam without SO(2) transition
apply a post-hoc orthonormalization that silently changes the transported frame
treat fixed RK4 step count as an adaptive global error bound
classify caustic from a near-zero sampled determinant without root and singular-value refinement
compare Sachs and canonical Jacobi matrices in different screen gauges
clip the smaller singular value to fabricate a finite magnification
